items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: But when they come down to playing the real orchestra, Scott Joplin, I'm a Sidney Desvene, Maple Leaf band, that was a known band

ctx.x: That's all. Did they ever play any of those members you were saying that Buddy Petit played like Scott Joplin?

Yeah. But there ain't many. Outside of one band used to play that, I mean, I'm talking about band, I'm not talking about orchestra. It was Rene. Rene was more so near to that kind of stuff than any other band around there. But when they come down to playing the real orchestra, Scott Joplin, I'm a Sidney Desvene, Maple Leaf band, that was a known band, and the Tuxedo band. That was three known best bands around there. And the P. Ron's band.
But you say the other bands, they would play some of that. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
